plugins.name: ppt-generator
plugins.description: Auto-generate presentations in Claude Code. The MCP server owns prompts, output schemas, and deterministic post-processing (validation, layout, lint, HTML/PPTX render); the client generates the slide content via a prepare/ingest handshake — no server-side LLM. Ships ppt-outline / ppt-design / ppt-modify / ppt-visual-qa skills.
